extra.final_summary: Found and fixed: 1) 'FEMALE' standardized to 'female' in sex column (low risk). 2) Two impossible negative flipper lengths (-185, -212) marked as missing. 3) Two body mass values (4.45M, 5.7M g) marked as missing due to likely data entry errors (extra zeros). The analysis uses the remaining 65 penguins. Average body mass: Adelie 3667.86g, Chinstrap 3726.67g, Gentoo 5228.33g.
